items.what: Google loads its map of the business and may set its own cookies and record the visitor's IP address, as Google does on google.com
items.when: only after a visitor taps "Show the map" on a page that has the map
items.shared: Google Maps, when a visitor opens the map

items.what: The visitor's browser loads a map picture of an office from Google, which sees the visitor's IP address
items.when: only on office cards that show a map picture, which needs a map key set on Your business, Offices

notes: Optima Core sets no cookies. Its email guard only changes how email addresses are written into the page, and it stores nothing. The map ([optima_map]) loads nothing from Google until a visitor taps it.
